query: Which KPIs (with calculation formulas) and decision rules should be used to monitor time-to-decision, uptake, privacy incidents, and stakeholder satisfaction during pilots?

response.query: Which KPIs (with calculation formulas) and decision rules should be used to monitor time-to-decision, uptake, privacy incidents, and stakeholder satisfaction during pilots?
response.answer: KPIs: Time-to-decision: Average decision time; Uptake: Adoption rate; Privacy incidents: Incidents per 100,000 users; Stakeholder satisfaction: Net Promoter Score (NPS). Decision rules: Time-to-decision < 10 days; Uptake > 70%; Privacy incidents < 5 per 100,000 users; NPS > 50.
